**Reference comparison summary:**
- **Soybean_rust**: References showed field-level views of dying/yellowing plants — not direct close-up pustule matches, but the orange-red leaf discoloration pattern is consistent with rust uredinia
- **Cercospora (107)**: Closest close-up match among references — green leaf with many small reddish spots — but the test image has far more extensive orange coloring rather than discrete spots on green background
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Yellowed leaves with distinct dark/black spots — color profile doesn't match the orange hue of the test image
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Small dark spots on green background — not matching
- All other classes showed clearly different patterns (necrotic edges, white mold, vein patterns, seed staining)

The orange coloration and dense small pustule distribution across the test image is most consistent with **Soybean_rust** — the uredinia pustules cause this characteristic orange-brown discoloration that spreads across leaves as the disease progresses.
